ability.value: If this creature takes damage at any point, begin morbing, regenerating 3 HP per turn while morbing. After morbing for 2 turns, become fully morbed, gaining dark type, +2 DEF, and 50% lifesteal on attacks. May consume an action to begin YIIKing out, gaining +1 SPD while YIIKing. After YIIKing for 2 turns become fully YIIKed, gaining +2 ATK and +1 SPD. This creature can either only be morbed or only YIIKed.
